C0574.title: Woman Exploits Supermarket Loophole for 18 Months of Zero-Dollar Shopping, Defrauds ¥250,000
C0574.summary: A woman exploited a loophole in a supermarket's operations, obtaining goods through zero-dollar purchases over a year and a half, with the total amount involved reaching ¥250,000. The act constitutes suspected fraud and has been filed for criminal investigation by the police.

references.title: Woman exploited supermarket loophole for 'zero-dollar shopping,' scammed 250,000 yuan over 1.5 years, suspected of fraud
